guards.issue: MECHANISM EV-4, one verdict at every FORCED site (rule 3). The sim does model the offer contract elsewhere -- Event.resume_after_combat RETURNS potions 'to surface as take-or-skip offers (RewardsCmd.OfferCustom)' (events/base.py:116-122), which is how battleworn_dummy hands its Setting1 potion to the driver -- so this is an inconsistency inside the sim, not a missing capability. Declining is a real choice: a card reward can be a card the player does not want in the deck, and a potion offer can be declined to keep a belt slot for a later pick. The source distinguishes the two screens deliberately: BrainLeech's SHARE_KNOWLEDGE sets `Cancelable = false` on its grid pick (BrainLeech.cs:67-70) while its RIP branch uses plain OfferCustom (BrainLeech.cs:58). LIVE at every site listed, all of which are reachable event branches with no exotic gate.
